title: Fashion Designer
description: Company Description Liorah is a growing fashion brand committed to creating distinctive, high-quality garments that blend contemporary design with refined craftsmanship. The company focuses on thoughtful details, premium materials, and a strong connection between concept and final product. Team members collaborate across design, production, and customer-facing functions to deliver cohesive collections. Liorah values creativity, accountability, and collaboration, and offers opportunities to contribute ideas and grow professionally. The brand is building a reputation for innovative designs and consistent quality in the local and regional fashion market. Role Description The Fashion Designer at Liorah is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The person in this role will develop design concepts, create sketches, and translate ideas into detailed technical drawings and specifications for production. Day-to-day tasks include selecting fabrics and materials, working with textiles and embellishments, collaborating with pattern makers and tailors, and overseeing fittings to achieve the desired silhouette and quality. The Fashion Designer will contribute to seasonal collections, participate in design reviews, and ensure designs align with brand identity and market trends. The role also involves coordinating with production teams, providing feedback on prototypes, and maintaining clear documentation of designs and revisions. Qualifications Strong skills in Fashion Design and Fashion, including concept development, sketching, and creating cohesive collections. Demonstrated ability working with Textiles, including fabric selection, drape evaluation, and material combinations. Practical experience with Fitting, garment construction details, and refining designs on live models or dress forms. Proficiency in Embroidery and other decorative techniques, with an eye for detail and quality finishing. Relevant education in Fashion Design or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Competence in using design tools (manual or digital), such as sketching software or CAD for fashion, is beneficial. Strong visual communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret and apply feedback. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple design projects within deadlines. Knowledge of current fashion trends and local market preferences; experience in Ethiopian or regional fashion markets is an advantage.

title: Architectural Engineering Technician - Senior Associate
description: Job Highlight This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to impactful infrastructure development projects in the Horn of Africa, working within a dynamic and mission-driven environment. The role offers exposure to diverse project types, advanced design software, and cross-functional collaboration, providing significant professional growth in architectural engineering and project support within the UN system. You will play a key role in ensuring the technical integrity and quality of design outputs that directly benefit communities. Role Purpose The Architectural Engineering Technician Senior Associate performs specialized technical support services in architectural and engineering design, integrating multiple processes to ensure high-quality design documentation and coordination for infrastructure and building projects. The candidate applies professional principles of architectural engineering to manage service delivery, contributes to process improvements, and ensures the integrity and accuracy of design outputs. Functions / Key Results Expected Under the overall supervision of the Senior Project Manager, the Architectural Engineering Technician Senior Associate s hall perform the following duties, including but not limited to: Design Preparation Contribute to the preparation of CAD drawings, 3D models, Renderings, and design documentation for infrastructure and building projects, including preliminary design drawings. Support the development of design concepts and presentations to ensure timely, cost-effective, and quality delivery. Utilize relevant software tools to prepare drawings that convey materials, technical specifications, dimensions, and construction requirements. Prepare architectural drawings including plans, sections, elevations, site layouts, and detailed working drawings using the latest version of AutoCAD, REVIT or equivalent software. Produce structural drawings (e.g., floor plans, columns, beams, reinforcement detailing) based on inputs provided by the relevant professionals. Prepare drawings for disciplines including sanitary, electrical, mechanical based on information provided by the relevant professionals. Ensure drawings are prepared in accordance with given instructions, schematic designs, and technical specifications. Assist in the preparation of as-built drawings and project documentation. Design Review and Revision Support the revision and updating of design drawings for new and existing buildings and infrastructure projects. Site Coordination and Technical Support Participate in technical coordination meetings and attend site visits as required. Desired A Technical/Professional Diploma is desired and may substitute for some of the years of experience required. Proficiency in AutoCAD is required. Desired Experience of working in multicultural environments or UN system organizations in a developing country is desired.

title: Head of Branch Office
description: Company Description The Confederation of Ethiopian Trade Unions (CETU) is the national umbrella organization representing workers across diverse sectors in Ethiopia. CETU works to promote fair labor practices, protect workers’ rights, and support social dialogue among employees, employers, and government bodies. The Confederation provides guidance and services to branch and member unions, helping them address workplace challenges and improve conditions. CETU also engages in advocacy, training, and capacity-building initiatives aimed at strengthening the voice and representation of workers throughout the country. Role Description The Head of Branch Office will lead and manage the Confederation of Ethiopian Trade Unions branch in Dire Dawa, Ethiopia. This full-time, on-site role is responsible for overseeing daily branch operations, coordinating union activities, and ensuring effective service delivery to members. Key tasks include supervising staff, planning and executing branch programs, organizing meetings and trainings, and maintaining accurate records and reports. The Head of Branch Office will engage with workers, employers, and local authorities, provide guidance on labor issues, and support collective bargaining and dispute resolution processes. The role also involves monitoring compliance with CETU policies and national labor regulations, promoting membership growth, and representing the branch in regional forums and consultations. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with workers, employers, and public institutions. Sound understanding of labor relations, workers’ rights, and relevant Ethiopian labor laws or willingness to learn these frameworks. Proven ability in conflict resolution, negotiation, and problem-solving in workplace or community settings. Experience working in trade unions, civil society organizations, or similar membership-based institutions is an advantage. Proficiency in written and spoken English and local languages commonly used in Dire Dawa is beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in management, labor studies, law, social sciences, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience may be considered. Commitment to equity, inclusiveness, and non-discriminatory practices in all aspects of branch leadership.
